configLoading.description: Whether the {@link SourceSystem} is currently loading or refreshing its {@link sourceSystemConfig}.

pingLoading.description: Whether the {@link SourceSystem} is currently loading or refreshing its {@link pingResult}.

sourceCollectionsLoading.description:
Whether the {@link SourceSystem} is currently loading or refreshing its {@link SourceCollection}s. Once fetched,
the {@link SourceCollection}s will be loaded into the
{@link SelfServiceDIDataSourcesCacheApplicationState.sourceCollectionsCache}.

sourceSystemConfig.description:
The configuration of the {@link SourceSystem}, including credentials and other fields needed to establish the
connection.

pingResult.description: Whether the {@link SourceSystem} is was reachable when it was last pinged.

credentialsForRootUrlUnavailable.description:
Whether the {@link SourceSystem}'s could not be retrieved, but it is still configured. This is necessary when specific mounts are associated
the {@link SourceSystem#rootUrlOverride}

title: Cached information about a {@link SourceSystem} for quick lookup for use in the UI.
name: SelfServiceDISourceSystemCacheItem
